text: The worsening morning throbbing combined with visual disturbances is concerning for increased intracranial pressure or a space-occupying lesion. Does the headache worsen when you bend over or cough, and do you experience any nausea or vomiting? REQUEST TEST: MRI Brain with contrast.

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: MRI Brain: Evidence of increased intracranial pressure with signs compatible with idiopathic intracranial hypertension. No masses or lesions observed.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Idiopathic Intracranial Hypertension (Pseudotumor Cerebri). Given the MRI findings of increased intracranial pressure without a mass lesion, along with your worsening morning headaches and visual aura, this is the most likely diagnosis. We will need to perform a lumbar puncture to confirm the diagnosis by measuring your opening pressure and check for papilledema on an eye exam.
